import sys
import math

MOD = 998244353

def power(x, y, p):
    res = 1
    x = x % p
    while y > 0:
        if y & 1:
            res = (res * x) % p
        y >>= 1
        x = (x * x) % p
    return res

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    tokens = input_line.split()
    N = int(tokens[0])
    M = int(tokens[1])
    L = int(tokens[2])
    R = int(tokens[3])
    temp = N * M
    exp = temp
    base = R - L + 1
    if (N * M) % 2 == 1:
        res = pow(base, exp, MOD)
        print((res + MOD) % MOD)
    else:
        res = pow(base, exp, MOD)
        if (R - L) % 2 == 0:
            res += 1
        res = (res * power(2, MOD - 2, MOD)) % MOD
        print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
